# 12 — Stroke records

*Written by the suite from [`tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd`](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

StrokeRecord as the wire format: what it writes, what it reads back, and
what its hash covers.

`tests/records/test_record_schema.gd` already checks that the fixtures on
disk have the right *shape*. This suite checks the class that will produce
them from M1 on: that a record survives its own serialisation, that the hash
covers what §2.2 says it covers and nothing else, and that `after` really is
derived -- editing a stored hash has to be detectable, or the "a relay is a
mailbox, not a referee" argument does not hold.

## What the suite asserts

- [An opened record has not been simulated yet](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L28)
- [Resolving fills in the result and the hash](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L37)
- [The hash covers the result and not the inputs](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L46)
- [A tampered hash is detectable](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L65)
- [A record survives a json round trip](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L73)
- [The intent survives the round trip exactly](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L95)
- [Intent values are quantized at construction](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L104)
- [The m0 fixture loads through the class](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L117)
- [Notation is the derived one line view](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L129)
- [Notation is never parsed back](../tests/records/test_stroke_record.gd#L139)
